label: Bible Study
prompt: Let your light so _____ before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verse: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
note: From the Sermon on the Mount — the light is for showing, the glory is for God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He hath made every thing _____ in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verse: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
note: Every thing beautiful 'in his time' — God's schedule runs on beauty, not on hurry.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Enter into his gates with _____, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verse: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
note: The gate password is thanksgiving; praise gets you into the courts.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The heart is _____ above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verse: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
note: Jeremiah's warning: the least trustworthy narrator you know lives in your own chest.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your _____ service.
verse: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
note: Your 'reasonable service' — worship that makes sense. Modern versions say 'spiritual worship.'
